transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

I... I'm not really used to talking about this kind of stuff. I guess I'm just having a hard time. 

My daughter left for basic training recently, and... I don't know. I come home to a dead house now. I just can't seem to keep myself together. Um... I'm sitting in my truck crying before my shifts. I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years... snapping at the younger guys at the shop. 

I haven't even been going out on the water, or working on my sculptures... I just don’t see the point right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About a month. Um... yeah, pretty much right after she shipped out. It's just been like this since then.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately?
Um... no. Not really. I guess I'm eating about the same. I haven't really checked my weight or anything, but... it seems fine.
Have you been having any trouble sleeping lately, like waking up in the middle of the night or feeling tired even after a full night’s sleep?
Um... no, not really. I usually just crash when I get to bed. I haven't really noticed any problems with it.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like working on your sculptures or being out on the water?

Yeah... I guess. I haven't been out on the water. Haven't touched my sculptures, either. I just... I don't really see the point lately. 

Um... since she left for basic, it's just... I come home to a dead house, and I just can't seem to keep myself together. It's... I don't know. I've been sitting in my truck crying before my shifts. Missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years... snapping at the younger guys on the crew. So... yeah. I'm not really doing the things I used to.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, since your daughter left for basic training?
Um... I don't know about all day. I mean... once I get into the shop and start working, I'm just doing my job. It's not really a whole day thing, I don't think. I just... I don't know.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough or that you’re failing at things lately?
No... I don't think so. I mean, I know I'm good at my job, even if I've been messing up a bit lately. I'm just... distracted. I don't feel like a failure or anything.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or focusing on tasks lately, like while you're working on welding jobs or doing other things?
No... I don't think so. I mean, once my hood is down, I can focus fine. I'm just... distracted sometimes, like I said. But I can still concentrate on the work.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything or blaming yourself for things lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I haven't done anything to feel guilty about, so... no.
Have you been having any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?
No. I... no. I wouldn't do anything like that.
You mentioned earlier that you don’t feel down all day. Can you describe what your mood is like in the mornings before work or in the evenings after you get home?

I don't really know. Um... in the mornings, I just... get up and go. I'm not really thinking about how I feel, I just have to get out the door. And at night... I'm just tired. I just want to sit down. That's... that's about it.
